current.text: He is likely to come off the bench. The projected Utah starting lineup is Keyonte George, Darryn Peterson, Lauri Markkanen, Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic.
Utah's roster is crowded at his spots: George, Peterson, Sensabaugh, Ace Bailey, Markkanen and Jackson all need minutes and touches.
His fantasy value is seen as finished after Utah's draft moves.
His strong finish to last season came from tank-period minutes. Utah is deeper now and plays to win, so experts expect those late-season minutes to be gone.
Utah is not tanking this season. Experts expect a playoff-level team (Leaf projects 43 wins and a 7th or 8th seed).
Utah's minutes and usage are expected to be all over the place early in the season.

note: Yahoo and ESPN both value him at 0 USD and rank him 238 and 228, far outside the 144 players we draft. The experts say his value is finished now that Utah is deep and trying to win, so do not draft him. His 95th-place finish after the trade deadline came from tank-period minutes that are expected to be gone. His projected line gives only threes, FT% and low turnovers, with little in rebounds, assists, steals or blocks. Early in the season, look at him on waivers only if injuries to Utah's wings or the unsettled early rotation give him starter minutes.
